subject: Disconnected-site media handback: acceptance window & operator sign-off
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logistics - CargoTransit <logistics@cargo.com>, paul.jensen@acme-corp.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Disconnected-site media handback: acceptance window & operator sign-off

Hi Paul / Cargo team,

Per the scheduled delivery for site-SEA-3 on 2026-09-17, we need to confirm the operator acceptance window and the exact handback procedure for the sealed media. Key asks: 

- Final ETA at the site gate (local time).
- Proof-of-delivery flow we should expect (signed manifest + courier badge photos).
- Whether the courier can wait up to a 2-hour acceptance window in case the on-site operator needs to complete a short integrity check.

Marissa, Markus — can you confirm the on-site operator name and the exact acceptance checklist we want them to run (hash checks, signature verification, ephemeral key handshake)? We want the site operator to sign the attached acceptance form and return a scan to irene.choi@redwoodinference.com.

I will be on the phone during the handoff window. Please keep the manifest visible and include manifest version (v1.4) on the signature.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Program Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

--
From: Logistics - CargoTransit <logistics@cargo.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, paul.jensen@acme-corp.com
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:31:18 -0700
Subject: Re: Disconnected-site media handback: acceptance window & operator sign-off

On Tue, Sep 15, 2026 at 9:12 AM Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Per the scheduled delivery for site-SEA-3 on 2026-09-17, we need to confirm the operator acceptance window...

Hi Irene —

Confirmed ETA: 2026-09-17 10:30 local (PDT) with +/- 30m traffic buffer. Courier can wait up to 90 minutes on-site (standard for this route) but prefers firm window start/finish for staffing.

Proof flow we will supply:
- signed_manifest.pdf (PDF of physical signature + timestamp)
- courier_chain_of_custody.txt (plain-text record of handoffs with geo stamps)
- two courier badge photos (if requested)

We can accommodate a 2-hour acceptance window if you give us a hard start time. Please confirm operator name and verification steps by end of day 2026-09-16 to lock resources.

Regards,
Cargo Transit Operations
logistics@cargo.com

--
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: paul.jensen@acme-corp.com, Logistics - CargoTransit <logistics@cargo.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Disconnected-site media handback: acceptance window & operator sign-off

Thanks, Logistics.

Operator at SEA-3: Anil Mehta (anil.mehta@acme-corp.com) — his mobile is +1-206-555-0182. Acceptance checklist for the operator: 

1) Inspect external tamper seal and courier manifest. Record seal ID into operator_acceptance_form.xlsx (column A).
2) Compute SHA256 of the received image bundle on the operator workstation and verify against manifest (column B).
3) Confirm operator device time sync (NTP within 5s) and record time.
4) Sign the manifest physically and scan; upload the scan to our secure intake SFTP (or send as encrypted email if SFTP unavailable).
5) If any mismatch, do NOT power on the target appliance — call the Redwood on-call (Connor) immediately.

We will accept a 2-hour window starting 10:30 local. If courier is delayed beyond the buffer please have them wait at the gate and send the badge photos + chain_of_custody file.

Attachments: operator_acceptance_form.xlsx (template), acceptance-template-notes.txt

Marissa Cole
Manager, Field Deployments
Redwood Inference

--
From: Paul Jensen <paul.jensen@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 12:02:33 -0700
Subject: Re: Disconnected-site media handback: acceptance window & operator sign-off

Thanks everyone — confirmed. I will ensure Anil is at the gate at 10:15 and runs the checklist. Two notes from Acme security: 
- We will photograph the courier badge and include it in the signed_manifest.pdf.
- Acme asks that Redwood confirm the expected manifest hash ahead of time (we will not open the bundle before acceptance steps are complete).

Paul Jensen
Security Operations Lead, Acme Corp
paul.jensen@acme-corp.com

Quick post-handoff note: handoff completed at 10:42 local. Attached signed_manifest.pdf and courier_chain_of_custody.txt from Cargo Transit. Operator reported hash match; Anil scanned the physical signature and uploaded the completed operator_acceptance_form.xlsx to our SFTP.

- Connor to verify manifest SHA256 against our on-record manifest and close the intake ticket.
- Markus to run signed-image activation in maintenance window 03:00-04:00 UTC on 2026-09-19 and notify site.

Thanks all — clean handoff.
